name: Cut-Paper Vivid
tagline: jaredcassoutt/vox-editorial: vivid cut-paper collage — saturated grounds, thick white sticker borders, per-letter colour, stop-motion overlays at 12 fps. (Figtree → Inter.)

motion.direction: vox-editorial cut-paper collage. Grounds rotate per beat between cobalt (`goldd`), marigold (`gold`), coral (`ter`) and cream (`stage`); never a dark ground. Every photo is a scissored cut-out with a thick white sticker border (`imageCard`s, tilted 2–6°), layered at different depths so they drift at different speeds (parallax). Headlines in Anton on torn stock; numbers as big `counter`s. Kinetic overlays move on a 12 fps stop-motion grid inside the 30 fps edit (held poses, built by hand). One idea per beat, 7–10 beats.
